question: Does exact-gradient HS training (pseudo-likelihood start, then stochastic maximum likelihood with persistent HS block-Gibbs chains and Rao-Blackwellized exact-DP gradients) recover the unchanged Version-4 energy, interactions included, at interaction strengths up to the stress world's ~7, with a log Z estimator accurate enough to score it?

worlds.form: Version-4 energy: b + Gram interactions Phi Phi' - rho_c C(n_c,2) - rho_0(|S|); 18 products, 10 categories (5 substitute groups + singletons), nonempty baskets of size <= 5, all 12,615 enumerated
worlds.contexts: 100 households x 8 weeks; household taste rank 3, household price sensitivity exp(delta_h), weekly randomized prices
worlds.strength_definition: top eigenvalue of Phi Phi' (rank 3, cross-category complements)
worlds.calibration_on_dev_seed_101: exact MLE (started at truth) is 0.006-0.008 nats/basket below truth on test at these sizes

development_changes: IS proposal enlarged after the dev run failed Gate E (64 components/512 draws -> 256 components thin 4 / 2048 draws); training settings unchanged from the first dev run

frozen_settings.pseudo_likelihood: LBFGS, 8 rounds x 200 iterations, priors theta/alpha precision 1/0.8^2, delta 1/0.5^2 (divided by N)

gates.gate_E: on the HS-SML fit: mean |log Z_hat - log Z| <= 0.01 and max <= 0.05 nats over 200 test contexts
gates.gate_T: exact test log-likelihood: truth minus HS-SML <= 0.02 nats/basket, and correlation of the identified pair interaction (phi_i.phi_j - rho_c[same category], i<j) with truth >= 0.9

decision_rule: Step 1 passes only if Gate E and Gate T pass in all 9 confirmation worlds (3 seeds x 3 strengths). Otherwise back to design; no stress-world run.
diagnostic_arms_not_gated: exact MLE by enumeration started at truth
plug-in z = observed basket field (fit_fast_v4.py shortcut)
